payload.reason: The evidence clearly describes the data collection process using a crowdsourcing platform and the structure of the dialogs collected.

claims.text: The data was collected using the crowdsourcing platform CrowdFlower, where workers interacted with a chat-like interface to answer questions.
The dataset consists of 1900 dialogs collected from users discussing questions randomly selected from the Simple questions dataset.
The dialogs were annotated by expert annotators to label the correctness of user answers and to provide additional information such as paraphrases and explanations.
